label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Warning
items.text: Stephen Gallacher warned Brian Rolapp that forcing top PGA Tour players into a packed signature-event schedule is unlikely to work since stars like Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler prefer playing around 20 times a year rather than a condensed 30-event slate.

items.headline: LIV Golf’s Funding Uncertain
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau revealed Saudi Arabia’s PIF will end LIV Golf funding after 2026; LIV is seeking $250–$350 million to continue with a reduced 10-event team-golf format while DeChambeau tries to regain form after missing cuts at this year's Masters and PGA.

items.headline: Clark, Koepka Withdraw From Schwab
items.text: Wyndham Clark and Brooks Koepka both withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge before it started, removing two recent major winners from the tournament field and impacting star power at Colonial.
